author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v4.7.3 - 2026-10-17
- build(deps): bump mcp from 2.0.0 to 2.2.0 in /tests in the pip group across 1 directory ([#548](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/548), @app/dependabot)
- fix: evict code and rule backups only past a configurable storage budget, with a File Manager backup index (#550)
  - Backups are no longer limited to 20 in total: they are removed only when they exceed a storage budget, so editing or deleting many items no longer removes the backup of something you edited earlier.
  - New advanced setting "Backup storage budget (MB)", default 10 MB, from 1 MB up to 1,000,000 MB; it can also be changed through the MCP settings tool with Developer Mode on. When the budget is exceeded, the oldest per-write snapshots go first, then the oldest pinned baselines.
  - The first backup of an editing session is kept as a pinned baseline. With "Back up before every native app edit" on, later snapshots in the session are kept as rolling steps.
  - Responses that offer a backup to restore now say how long that backup is kept, and the backup list shows the storage used and the budget.
  - Writing or deleting a file in File Manager now keeps only the five newest automatic backup copies of that file.
  - Existing backup records move out of the app's state into a small index file, and backup files from older versions are picked up and managed automatically.
  - If the backup index file cannot be read, backups are paused with a clear error instead of being rebuilt over it, and an unreadable index is saved aside before it is replaced.

v4.7.2 - 2026-10-15
- Chore: Update pull request template for testing section (#535)
- chore: update test dependencies and track compatibility lanes and forks (#534)
- ci: skip dependency-only bot E2E and prevent bot-triggered app releases (#541)
- chore(deps): update gradle to v9.8.1 ([#537](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/537), @app/renovate)
- build(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6 to 7 in the github-actions group across 1 directory ([#540](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/540), @app/dependabot)
- chore(deps): update dependency renovate to v44.154.0 ([#538](https://github.com/kingpanther13/Hubitat-local-MCP-server/pull/538), @app/renovate)
- test: compile watchdog v3.1 once per test process (#542)
- feat: native Hub Variables endpoints and Software E2E result consumption (#545)
  - Support current Hub Variables configuration endpoints while retaining compatibility with older hubs.
  - `hub_delete_connector` accepts `force`; without it the tool refuses when an app uses the connector.
  - `hub_get_variable(includeDependents=true)` also lists apps that use the variable's connector device.

v4.7.1 - 2026-10-12
- feat: add appTypeId to hub_list_apps(scope='instances') rows (#527)
  - `hub_list_apps(scope='instances')` rows now include `appTypeId`, the app type's code id, so an installed app can be linked to its Apps Code entry (`hub_get_source`, `scope='types'`, `/app/editor/<id>`) without matching on the type name.

v4.7.0 - 2026-10-11
- docs: note mcp-proxy 0.13.0 fixes the startup crash, keep mcp-remote for Claude Desktop (#528)
  - Claude Desktop docs: `mcp-proxy` 0.13.0 starts again without an SDK pin, but slow writes still need `mcp-remote` with `--protocol auto`.
- feat: deliver one inlined parent app through HPM instead of a library bundle (#525)
  - Installs and updates through Hubitat Package Manager are now a single app save instead of a bundle plus an app save, so an update no longer fails with "Read timed out" and then retries; on a C-8 an update takes about four minutes instead of nine.
  - The Groovy libraries are no longer installed separately. After this update the old `mcp` libraries and the `mcp_libraries` bundle remain under Libraries Code and Bundles as unused code; they can be deleted by hand at any time.
  - Manual (non-HPM) installs now use the release build URLs on the `bundle-artifacts` branch (see README).
  - If you upgrade from 4.6.0 or earlier with the Developer-Mode `hub_update_package` tool, do that one upgrade through HPM instead: the 4.6.0 tool expects a library bundle and refuses the new layout. From this version on it deploys any ref again.
  - Updating app code from a URL (`importUrl`) no longer writes a pre-update source backup to File Manager: the previous version lives wherever that URL is published. Updates from inline source or a File Manager file still back up first unless you pass `backup: false`.
  - A Developer-Mode self-update now returns as soon as the hub has accepted the save (`status: "saving"`) and `hub_get_info` reports when the new version is compiled, instead of the request timing out after five minutes.
  - Deleting the leftover `mcp` libraries after the upgrade is recommended: each one adds about half a second to the Libraries Code page and to `hub_list_libraries` on a C-8 (README explains).
